title: Arrival requirements changed
previousText: Visitors from Region A may arrive without an advance digital form.
updatedText: Starting November 1, 2026, visitors from Region A must complete the digital arrival form before departure.

title: Submission form replaced
updatedText: Effective October 1, 2026, form Q-14 is retired. All new applications must use form Q-18.

title: Population limitation clarified
previousText: The study compared outcomes across enrolled participants.
updatedText: The comparative study enrolled adults only. Findings cannot be generalized to children from the available dataset.

title: Sponsorship metadata updated
updatedText: Product feature article is paid content and requires a visible sponsorship label.
